We tried to complete the supplier onboarding this morning but keep getting an error when following the SSO link from your invitation. The portal returns: "SAML response rejected: NameID format not recognized" and then redirects to an error page. We've tried Chrome and Edge, incognito, clearing cookies — same result.

We need to get the onboarding finished to receive the first PO (scheduled for 11/20). I've attached a short SSO trace from our IdP and a screenshot of the error. Hi Elena — thanks for the logs and screenshot. Sorry for the friction — we should be able to get you across the finish line quickly. A couple quick items to triage from our side: 

- Can you confirm the tenant alias you clicked the invite for (the invite link contains a tenant param, e.g. tenant=sparrowtech-prod)?
- Do your IdP outgoing SAML assertions include these attributes: email, persistent-id, and/or uid? If you only send email as NameID that may be the mismatch.
- For a fast workaround, I can generate a one-time magic invite link that will bypass SAML and let your admin upload the W-9 and bank details. That link expires in 48 hours.

In parallel I've looped Marcus from infra to look at the trace you attached and advise whether the SP can accept email as NameID or if we need IdP remapping. Also attaching our supplier onboarding checklist & a blank acceptance form to speed the PO flow.

Attachments: sparrow_acceptance_form.pdf (application/pdf), onboarding-checklist.md (text/markdown)

If it helps, can we book a 20-minute screenshare this afternoon? I have 3pm or 4:30pm PT free.

On Mon, Nov 9, 2026 at 12:05 PM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elena — thanks for the logs and screenshot. Sorry for the friction — we should be able to get you across the finish line quickly.

Thanks for the trace, Elena — I pulled the SAML response from the log you sent. The assertion shows NameID is being sent as "urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress" with value "elena@sparrowtech.io". Our supplier portal (the SP) currently prefers "urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent" (a persistent identifier) for tenant-bound accounts.

Two ways to resolve:
1) Recommended (IdP-side): Update your IdP attribute mapping to emit a persistent NameID or include an attribute called "persistent-id" and map it to NameID for the Redwood SP config. Example mapping snippet for Okta/OneLogin is below.

2) Quick workaround (SP-side): We can temporarily allow emailAddress as an accepted NameID for your tenant and send you a magic link invite so you can finish onboarding while IdP mapping is changed. This needs a one-time ops change (low risk) and will be rolled back after we confirm persistence mapping.

Sample attribute mapping (Okta):
- NameID format: persistent
- NameID value: user.uid or user.<customPersistentId>
- Additional attributes: email -> user.email, givenName -> user.firstName, familyName -> user.lastName

I can flip the SP acceptance flag for SparrowTech and generate the magic invite if Ben confirms. Also opened OPS ticket OPS-1129 to track the change.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
